purpose: Coarse visible-form robustness diagnostic only, never exact identity, composition, packaging, safety, deposit or sorting truth.
limitations: AI visual review only, requiring independent human review; source pretraining membership unknown. Fixed models are compared without training. Public catalogue/search acquisition is not representative real-camera sampling. Reusable containers/tableware, same-kind multi-object scenes, top-down cups, partial tote handles and historical transistor boxes are disclosed domain challenges. Historical transistor object groups share a source-era family and both stay validation-only. All 48 public candidates, including excluded/reserve cases, were inspected before predictions; 32 references are frozen without selecting on model performance. Licence metadata does not establish all third-party rights, physical composition, safety, packaging status or sorting truth.

excluded.reason: Privacy exclusion: an identifiable child and other people are visible. Public copyright permission is not used as a privacy clearance.
Reserve not evaluated: the top and base are clipped; four clearer whole-form bottle groups were selected before any inference.
Eligibility exclusion: cap/neck close-up lacks the full bottle body and base. Do not derive whole-form label from filename.
Eligibility exclusion: jar rim and top are outside the frame; food dominates the macro. No whole-jar reference.
Reserve not evaluated: retail jar row is usable in principle but partial red container at the right and label business contact text add ambiguity; four cleaner groups selected before inference.
Privacy/eligibility exclusion: a shipping label is visible and full box bounds are clipped. Public business/product labels do not justify assuming a delivery address is non-private.
Eligibility exclusion: transparent mesh carrier exposes multiple cartons/containers; supported kinds compete in the same scene.
Reserve not evaluated: a cup dominates but a tall condiment container and several other vessels occur behind it. Cleaner cup groups selected before inference.
Eligibility exclusion: overhead rim-only coffee vessel has little depth/handle evidence, making cup-vs-bowl reference unnecessarily ambiguous.

Reserve not evaluated: many hanging bulbs provide an eligible outside-kind example, but six per-split controls were selected in advance to cover battery/aerosol/electronics/bowl/food/mixed challenges.
Reserve not evaluated: lit bulb is an eligible outside-kind reference, but balanced six-control held-out budget prioritizes harder packaging-like confusions.
Reserve not evaluated: a whole keyboard is eligible outside-kind, but the six-control validation budget already includes electronic cable plus five other distinct challenge categories.
Reserve not evaluated: keyboard macro is eligible outside-kind, but the six-control held-out budget already includes electronics plus five other challenge categories.
Eligibility exclusion: the small round lidded container beside the tall bottle is jar-like, making exclusive bottle truth ambiguous.
Eligibility exclusion: several bottles, jars and other vessels share the kitchen scene; source title alone is not an exclusive jar reference.
